column1: # Sweeps --clsselectp in {0,10,20,30} riding the current compiled defaults
# (slope=500, floor=80, min_weight=10, oldestsource=1). clsselectp is the
# random-source-shortcut probability in percent: with probability clsselectp/100
# the neighbor scan is skipped and the sink draws random satisfied source(s)
# instead (also the only channel that moves weight between the positive- and
# negative-literal constraint classes). cs0 (never shortcut, always
# neighbor-scan) is the current default (baseline anchor); higher values inject
